extraction_details.b3_wire_rejection: the sealed b3-raw.json placed the OPTIONAL enum fields expected_information_gain / evaluation_cost inside mechanism; proposal-wire/v1 accepts them only at the proposal level, and the strict decoder rejected the payload (recorded verbatim: 'proposal wire schema violation: json: unknown field "expected_information_gain"'). The inherited prompt text was ambiguous about their placement.
extraction_details.transform: deterministic jq re-nesting moving ONLY those two fields from mechanism to the proposal level; losslessness machine-verified (all other content byte-identical); sealed raw bytes untouched
